name: Ransomware Precursor — SMB Enumeration + Large Outbound Egress
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302013" and xdm.source.port = 445
| filter xdm.target.ipv4 != null
| alter scanner = xdm.target.ipv4
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count_distinct(xdm.source.ipv4) as smb_hosts by scanner, _time
| filter smb_hosts >= 10
| join (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "302014"
    | alter int_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
            int_iface = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface,
            bytes_n = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
    | filter int_iface = "inside"
    | comp sum(bytes_n) as exfil_bytes by int_host
    | filter exfil_bytes >= 50000000
  ) as fw scanner = fw.int_host
| fields int_host, scanner
description: Same host enumerating SMB shares and uploading large outbound volume.
alert_name: Ransomware Precursor — SMB Enumeration + Large Outbound Egress
